newsitem.title: USA: Microchip sees record Q4 sales, EPS.
newsitem.headline: Microchip sees record Q4 sales, EPS.

text.p: Microchip Technology Inc said Wednesday that revenues and earnings for its fourth fiscal quarter, ended March 31, are expected to reach record levels.
The company said in a statement it expects earnings will be in line with the range of analysts' expectations.

Analysts have forecast Microchip will earn between $0.29 and $0.31 a share in its fourth quarter, compared with $0.25 a share in the comparable year-ago period, according to First Call. The company plans to release its results after the close of market on April 23.

"Microchip was highly dependent on turns business in the March quarter which resulted in reduced shipment visibility during the quarter," said Steve Sanghi, Microchip president and chief executive officer.
Microchip ended the quarter with more than $4 million in delinquent shipments from orders received late in the quarter which could not be shipped, the company said.

The company said its book-to-bill ratio for the March quarter was higher than in previous quarters which will add to visibility in the June quarter's shipment activity. But it cautioned that Microchip will continue to be highly dependent on turns orders and will remain susceptible to shipment delinquencies in the June quarter.
